SHORT VIDEO EDITOR FOR FB/YT Made for a simpler edit.

From raw footage to ready to post.

  1. Add one or more videos. They appear in timeline order.
  2. Remove unwanted parts. Select a clip. Scrub to the start, click Set start; scrub to the end, click Set end. Click Remove section.
  3. Arrange your story. Split clips, remove whole clips, or move them Earlier / Later. Undo is always there.
  4. Pick a format and export. Download the MP4, switch the format, and export again for the other platform.

ভিডিও সার্ভারে আপলোড হয় না। পেজ বন্ধ বা রিফ্রেশ করলে এডিট হারাবে। Export চলাকালে এই ট্যাব খোলা রাখুন।

The video engine loads about 32 MB the first time you export. Rendering may take several minutes. Desktop Chrome or Edge is recommended.
